connect.hint: The address you open the dashboard at.

link.denied: That was turned down in Polaris.
link.expired: That request ran out. Ask again.
link.approveIn: Approve this in the tab that opened. The code there should read:

popup.unreachable: Polaris can't be reached right now. You are still signed in, and the vault tries again every minute.
